title: Dangerous Goods Acceptance: Applicant Standing — Profile Age, Misdeclaration History and Resubmission After Rejection
content:
Three admission tests of Dangerous Goods Acceptance look at the applicant and its history rather than at the goods. Each is decided on the line's records, never on the customer's account of events, and each uses a figure of the category applied for.

## 1. Age of the customer profile

**Clause.** On the date of application, the applicant's profile with the line must be at least as old as the category's minimum profile age, counted in calendar days from the date the profile was opened.

**Boundary (hypothetical minimum of 100 days).** A profile opened on 2026-01-01 reaches 100 days on 2026-04-11: an application that day qualifies, one on 2026-04-10 does not. Reaching the minimum exactly is sufficient.

## 2. Recent misdeclaration penalties

**Clause.** The applicant may not have been charged a misdeclaration penalty within the category's block period preceding the application. The line counts the misdeclaration-penalty entries on the dangerous-goods accounts of that customer, on any of its acceptances, whose charge date falls within the trailing run of calendar days that ends on the handling date and is as long as the block period of the category now applied for. Any such entry keeps the application out; inspection cost recoveries are not part of this count.

**Illustration (hypothetical 60-day block).** A penalty charged 20 days back falls inside the window and the application is refused; a penalty charged 200 days back lies outside it and does not stand in the way.

## 3. Waiting after a rejection on the same booking

**Clause.** Where the previous application for a booking was rejected, a new application for that booking is taken only from a set date onward. That earliest date is the previous application's rejection date advanced by the category's waiting period, counted on calendar dates; an application made on that very date is taken, and one made on any earlier date is not. The rejection date is read from the line's record of the rejected acceptance on that booking.

**Boundary (hypothetical waiting period of 3 days).**

| Rejection date | Earliest date for a new application | Application on 2026-05-12 | Application on 2026-05-13 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-05-10 | 2026-05-13 | not taken | taken |

With a waiting period of zero, the earliest date is the rejection date itself.

## Authority

Profile opening date, the charge history of the customer and the rejection date are all system records; a customer's assertion about them does not alter the outcome of these tests.
